levels.label: Mk 1 · Depot
levels.description: The compact depot: ramps, low cover, corridors, and three patrolling guards.

levels.label: Mk 2 · Expanded depot
levels.description: A larger course with multiple elevations, longer patrols, credentials, and an extraction uplink.

levels.label: Mk 3 · Vent works
levels.description: Two guard-patrolled floors, thick service walls and five crawl routes: straight ducts, elbows, diagonal bends and a 45 degree riser. Find the service key, then extract upstairs.

levels.label: Mk 4 · Cargo works
levels.description: Move cargo with Use to uncover salvage and a vent. Stack a crate to climb the low salvage wall. Full-height partitions meet a solid ceiling: use the vents to reach the loading relay, then extract. The bench behind spawn has a pistol, rifle, shotgun and ammo; open the bag or press I to equip.

levels.label: Weapon gym · Arsenal
levels.description: Pick up weapons and ammunition with Use. Fire, reload and reset the practice targets. Includes the full experimental arsenal.

levels.label: Lab · Unarmed combat
levels.description: Experimental boxing, stamina, blocks, parries and guard breaks. Watch the sparring or take control.

levels.label: Lab · Evidence & distraction
levels.description: Throw a noise distraction and watch guards investigate uncertain evidence.

levels.label: Lab · Nonlethal takedown
levels.description: Approach from behind, restrain a guard and observe recovery. Experimental mechanics remain separate from the main gyms.

levels.label: Lab · Guard coordination
levels.description: Guards share delayed and uncertain reports over a radio network.
